attchmntText: Balaji Telefilms Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Balaji Telefilms Limited filed an investor presentation for the earnings conference call covering the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported consolidated income from operations of Rs. 181.15 crore for Q2 FY27, with a profit before tax of Rs. 44.86 crore and profit after tax of Rs. 32.51 crore. Earnings per share stood at Rs. 2.67. For the half year, revenue was Rs. 421.44 crore, with a profit after tax of Rs. 54.90 crore. The company announced a strategic partnership with Netflix for long-term content development and a collaboration with YouTube for five original shows. The film Bhooth Bangla crossed Rs. 240 crore in worldwide box office collections. The presentation is available on the company website at www.balajitelfilms.com.

attchmntText: Balaji Telefilms Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026, titled "Balaji Telefilms Records Strong QoQ & YoY Performance".
voiceSummary: Balaji Telefilms Limited submitted its press release and quarterly performance report for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported consolidated income from operations of 181.15 crore rupees for Q2 FY27. Profit before tax was 44.86 crore rupees with a margin of 24.76 percent. Profit after tax stood at 32.51 crore rupees, representing a margin of 17.95 percent. Earnings per share were 2.67 rupees. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, revenue was 421.44 crore rupees. Profit before tax was 72.87 crore rupees. Profit after tax was 54.90 crore rupees. Earnings per share were 4.52 rupees. The company announced a strategic partnership with Netflix for long-term content development. It also entered a collaboration with YouTube for five original shows. The film Bhooth Bangla crossed 240 crore rupees in worldwide box office collections. The company maintains a digital B2B order book above 350 crore rupees.

attchmntText: Please find enclosed the Monitoring Agency Report furnished by CRISIL.
voiceSummary: Balaji Telefilms Limited filed a Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, issued by Crisil Ratings Limited. The report covers the utilization of Rs 130.68 crore raised through a Preferential Issue of Equity Shares. The Monitoring Agency confirmed no deviation from the objects of the issue. As of the quarter end, Rs 38.98 crore was utilized, leaving Rs 91.70 crore unutilized. The unutilized proceeds were invested in mutual funds and corporate bonds with a market value of Rs 101.76 crore. Movie production utilized Rs 36.35 crore, while music and digital content utilized Rs 0.72 crore. General corporate purposes utilized Rs 1.92 crore. No delay in implementation was observed. The report is available on the company website.

attchmntText: Balaji Telefilms Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Balaji Telefilms Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on November 13, 2026. The Board considered and approved the Un-audited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. This approval covers both Standalone and Consolidated financial statements. The results include a Limited Review Report from auditors Deloitte Haskins & Sells LLP. The auditor confirmed that the statements comply with Indian Accounting Standard 34 and Listing Regulations. The report noted no material misstatements. The consolidated results include subsidiaries Balaji Motion Pictures Limited and Ding Infinity Private Limited. One subsidiary's financials were not reviewed by its auditor but were deemed immaterial. The company will publish the results in newspapers and on its website. The Board Meeting started at 04:00 p.m. and ended at 06:25 p.m.
